title: The Sailor's Debt
description: A contact in the Thieves Guild has a job for you. A sailor named Brennan owes a substantial debt to certain parties in Dalhurst. He's been avoiding payment for weeks now, drinking away his earnings at the Rusty Anchor. Strange thing is, Brennan had money a fortnight ago and drank the whole of it - he didn't steal it, and he won't say who gave it to him, only that the man doing the buying wasn't the man doing the paying. The Guild wants you to collect - by persuasion or force. Just don't make a scene that draws the guard's attention.

objectives.description: Find the sailor Brennan at the Rusty Anchor tavern
Collect the 150 gold debt (intimidate, persuade, or take by force)
Return the gold to the Guild fence

notes: Soulstone-thread touchpoint per docs/design/quest_web.md row 11 (Tell 2): Brennan's unexplained money and the buyer who wasn't the payer. Never named, never explained, gates nothing. Touchpoint-only edit; rest of quest left as originally written (already STORIED).
